author: EthanDupe

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.9 — Pure Algorithmic Akinator, Real-Card Blackjack, Kindle Snake, Pattern UNO, Battleship & Unified Zoom
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.9 Updates
- **Pure Algorithmic Akinator E-Ink (`khub-akinator`)**: 100% offline Bayesian entropy & multi-rival elimination algorithm across 80+ famous characters, historical figures, animals, and objects with 5-level confidence weighting, live Brain Peek, Undo history, and custom entity learning.
- **Kindle Blackjack (`khub-blackjack`)**: Real playing card designs with corner rank/suit indices, center pip grids, and crowned court cards (J/Q/K), 6-deck shoe, chip betting, Hit, Stand, Double Down, Split Pairs, Surrender, Insurance, and Basic Strategy Advisor.
- **Kindle Snake (`khub-snake`)**: High-contrast 15x15 canvas grid with patterned segments, large Kindle touch D-Pad + tap-board steering, adjustable E-Ink refresh speeds (including Step-Tap turn mode), and Solid Walls / Wrap-Around / Maze modes.
- **Kindle UNO (`khub-uno`)**: Simplified Uno against 1 or 2 Bots with E-Ink geometric suit emblems (`▲ RED`, `◆ BLUE`, `● GREEN`, `★ YELLOW`, `✦ WILD`), playable card badges, hand sorting, and `CALL UNO!` button.
- **Battleship E-Ink (2P & AI) (`khub-battleship`)**: Naval torpedo combat with 1P vs Smart AI Fleet and 2-Player Pass-and-Play mode.
- **Strict Maintenance Mode Verification & 15-Second Polling**: Checks Maintenance Mode across Cloudflare + JSONBin before opening the store or downloading any app.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.5 — +25% Zoomed Games, 2-Player & AI Hangman/Snake/Connect4/Checkers, Game Scaler & NOAA Emergency Plugin
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.5 Updates
- **+25% Larger Store Games & New Titles**: Zoomed in all Store Games by 25% and added **E-Ink Hangman (2P & AI)**, **Connect Four E-Ink (2P & AI)**, **E-Ink Minesweeper**, and **E-Ink Checkers (2P & AI)**.
- **Upgraded E-Ink Snake v2.0 (1P, 2P Dual Battle & 1P vs AI)**: Play solo, battle a friend head-to-head with dual left/right D-pads on the same Kindle, or race an AI rival snake.
- **2-Player Modes Across Existing Games**: Added 2P Secret Word mode to **Word Guess E-Ink**, 2P Turn Duel to **2048 E-Ink** & **Sudoku**, and 2P Co-Op Party mode to **AI Tap Adventure**.
- **All-New Plugin Lineup**: Removed old plugins and added **All-Games Zoom & Scale Booster** (`+15%` to `+50%`), **NOAA Emergency Weather Alert Monitor** (location-based, strictly active emergencies/warnings only), **E-Ink Ghosting Scrubber**, **Game Save Backup Vault**, and **In-Game Quick-Switch Dock**.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.4 — Added E-Ink Snake, Reliable Store Connection & Auto Low-Power at 20%
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.4 Updates
- **Added E-Ink Snake (`khub-snake`)**: High-contrast 10x10 Snake game with high-score saving, Auto-Run mode (650ms E-Ink refresh), and tap-to-step directional controls.
- **Reliable Store Connection & Local Fallback**: Fixed JSONBin CORS/SSL blocks on Kindle so the App Store connects reliably while still honoring maintenance mode.
- **Automatic Low-Power Mode at 20% Battery**: Live 15-second battery polling automatically enables Low Power Mode when your Kindle reaches 20% or lower.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.3 — JSONBin-First Server Lock, 10s Auto-Retry, Verified Downloads & 50% Larger Settings
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.3 Updates
- **JSONBin-First Store Verification & 10-Second Recovery Check**: Before opening or re-opening the App Store, KHub confirms with JSONBin first whether the store is online or offline, then fetches `kindlestore.json`. While the server is down, KHub checks every 10 seconds and strictly blocks opening the App Store until JSONBin and the server confirm it is back online.
- **Live Online Verification on Every App Download**: Every app/plugin download now displays `Verifying...` and checks JSONBin + the store server in real time before installing—blocking downloads immediately if the store is offline.
- **50% Larger Settings Screen**: Scaled all Settings category buttons, icons, headers, descriptions, inputs, and buttons up by 50%.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.2 — Categorized Settings with Icons, 3-Story RSS Pagination & Silent App Updates
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.2 Updates
- **Fixed Startup App Update Loop**: Fixed boot order so disk state never overwrites updated apps in `localStorage`, and silently auto-updates installed store apps in the background.
- **3-Article Paginated RSS Feed**: Shows 3 news stories at a time with **Prev / Next** arrow buttons so you never have to scroll.
- **Categorized Settings Menu with Icons**: Organized Settings into 5 icon categories (**AI & API Key**, **Display & Text Size**, **Battery & Power**, **Privacy & Tracking**, and **System & Updates**) with a back arrow to return to the Settings menu.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.1 — Fixed App/System Updater, Reset Software, 1h Tracking & Low Power Mode
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.1 Updates
- **Fixed App & System Updater**: Separate app updates from full system updates, prevent disk state from reverting app versions, and write browser-fetched updates directly to disk.
- **Reset Software Option**: Re-downloads KHub from GitHub to repair any errors while keeping your Kindle Tracking ID and API Key.
- **Persistent Device Tracking ID (`khub/tracking_id.txt`)**: Generated on first open, tracks built-in app & store usage locally, and syncs to JSONBin once every 1 hour with preloading (with a Settings toggle to turn Tracking off).
- **Low Power Mode & 20% Battery Warning**: Locks preloading to On-Demand to save battery and alerts you with a Battery-with-Bolt popup at 20% battery.
- **1.5x RSS Text Scaling**: Adjusted RSS font scaling from 5x to 1.5x of your Settings zoom.

storeChangelog.title: Store v2.0 — Strictly Online Store, Smart Update Badges, Upgraded Quick Notes & Admin Panel
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v2.0 Updates
- **Strictly Online-Only App Store**: Zero preloaded apps on device; blocks all offline downloads and displays a Cloud-with-X `No connection to server` screen when offline.
- **Accurate Offline vs. Server Error Detection**: Uses live un-cached internet probes to distinguish between no Wi-Fi/internet and an actual store server outage.
- **Smart Update Badges & Button**: The `Update` button now only appears when a newer version is available, replacing the `Launch` button in dark highlight style alongside an upper-left download icon badge.
- **Upgraded Quick Notes v2.0**: Multi-note slots (`Note 1`–`Note 4`), note titles, adjustable font size, live word/character counter, and saved timestamps.
- **Website Admin Panel & Maintenance Switch**: Live online Kindle telemetry and instant remote store maintenance lock via JSONBin.io.

storeChangelog.title: Store v1.8 — Classic Menu Categories, Fixed OTA Updater & Store Icons
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v1.8 Updates
- **Fixed OTA System Updater**: Downloads the latest update directly via browser HTTPS + local helper daemon so updates never loop or stay stuck.
- **Fixed Remote API Key Delivery & Auto-Stop**: Uses static `state.js` HTTP polling + `httpd` URL log capture + `/var/local/khub_www` CGI so pasting your key on Phone/PC immediately fills the Kindle input box, saves permanently, and stops the server.
- **Classic v1.6 Menu with Category Buttons**: Restored the classic full-width KHub menu (`KHub App Store`, `Games`, `Productivity`, `Misc`, `Settings`) with built-in and downloaded apps inside each category.
- **App Store Categories with Icons**: Filter store apps by **Games**, **Productivity**, **Misc**, and **All**.

storeChangelog.title: Store v1.5 — Disk Downloads & Dynamic AI Quest
storeChangelog.markdown:
## Store v1.5 Updates
- **On-Device Game Downloads**: Store games now download directly into `/khub/apps/<app-id>/` on your Kindle.
- **AI Tap Adventure v1.4**: Generates a **brand-new unique opening story and choices** every single time you start a new game using `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.
- **Cleaner AI Apps**: Removed in-app AI config buttons; all AI settings live exclusively in the main KHub Settings screen.
- **Server Status Detection**: Detects when your Kindle Wi-Fi is connected but the store server is down.
